closure.notice: Operator cancellation does not change the saved unfinished result into a normal failure or timeout; absent process-duration and token receipts remain unknown.

scope: Saved public output, counters and file hashes only; no analysis, replay, subprocess, Skill or private-session access.

normal_schedule.notice: Seven is the configured normal schedule, not a claim that seven processes have started or finished.

review_deliveries.notice: Complete persisted deliveries are measured, including envelopes and structural-correction context; none are rendered again or sent.

returned_model.notice: Absent public model metadata remains unknown; request configuration is not returned-model evidence.

timing.notice: Request durations can overlap and are not added to controller wall time. Missing durations remain unknown.

usage_notice: Missing counters are unknown, not zero. Total is input plus output; cache/reasoning counters are subsets. Public counters do not establish provider billing or internal HTTP attempts.

metadata_only_cli_invocations.details: This passive auditor invokes no CLI or process. Preparation history is not inferred from these request receipts.

cost_scope.notice: Counts and tokens include only requests physically recorded in the sole prepared cfg-recovery GA4 run. No predecessor or historical request is read or charged. accepted_answer_present and normal_schedule.accepted_answer_recorded describe transport delivery acceptance only; they do not establish structural or semantic acceptance.

internal_reconnect_notice: Stdout reconnect/network-wait notices and stderr sampling-retry/connection-wait lines overlap and must not be added. Sampling retry lines and connection-wait backoff lines are separately inventoried. They occur inside native processes and are not outer launches. Message ordinals and backoff durations do not establish provider HTTP-attempt counts or additional usage.
auxiliary_log_notice: Model-list refresh and MCP startup/reconnect/shutdown errors are separate auxiliary CLI activity. Their presence does not establish a failed analysis request or an additional model invocation. Exact lines are retained without converting them into provider HTTP attempts.
